en: Black‑and‑white image of a large, three‑storey, late‑19th‑century building seen from across a small park or garden. The facade has regularly spaced tall windows, rusticated ground floor, and more ornate upper storeys with pilasters and decorative gables above the central and left sections of the roof. Dormer windows project from a steep, dark roof with chimneys. Leafy trees and bushes partly obscure the lower part of the building, and a simple metal fence runs along the front, with fallen leaves on the ground suggesting autumn. There is no clearly legible printed title on the image, only some small, vertical markings along the right border that look like a handwritten or film-edge notation.
